question: Confirm the legal entity that will sign and the one that will deliver the service: registered name, registration number, country and registered address.
good_answer_includes: Exact registered names and numbers; group parent; any difference between the signing and the delivering entity explained
evidence_expected: Company registry extract; group structure chart

question: List the countries and sites from which the service will be delivered, supported and administered, and where our data will be stored or accessed.
good_answer_includes: Every country and site for delivery, support, administration and data storage; follow-the-sun support named

question: Who ultimately owns or controls your company (owners above 10%, or the threshold we specify), and has ownership or control changed in the last 24 months?
good_answer_includes: Named owners above the threshold, ownership percentages, any state ownership, recent changes

question: How many employees do you have, how many will work on our service, and what share of your annual revenue will our contract represent?
good_answer_includes: Headcount; team size for the service; approximate revenue share (dependency)

question: Do you hold current independent security assurance (for example ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification, a SOC 2 Type II report, CSA STAR, PCI DSS AOC) that covers the service you will provide to us?
good_answer_includes: Each report or certificate with standard and edition, issuer, period or validity dates and scope covering the entity, sites and service
evidence_expected: Certificates; SOC 2 Type II report with bridge letter if the period ended more than 3 months ago; STAR entry; AOC

question: Did the most recent independent report or audit include any exceptions, qualifications or nonconformities, and what was done about them?
good_answer_includes: Each exception or nonconformity, its root cause, the fix and the date closed
evidence_expected: Report exception section; management response; corrective action records

question: Which of your subservice providers were excluded (carved out) from that report, and which controls do you expect us to operate ourselves (complementary user entity controls)?
good_answer_includes: List of carved-out providers and their own assurance; list of controls the customer must run

question: Please list your security policies and procedures relevant to this service with their version and last review date.
good_answer_includes: Title, version, owner and last review date of each policy; reviewed within the last 12 months

question: Do you have a named person responsible for information security and a documented security policy approved by management and reviewed at least yearly?
good_answer_includes: Name and role of the security lead; reporting line; approval and review dates of the policy

question: How do you identify and assess information-security risks, how often, and who accepts residual risk?
good_answer_includes: Method, frequency (at least yearly and on major change), risk register, named risk owners and acceptance authority
evidence_expected: Risk methodology; extract of risk register (redacted)

question: How is security performance reported to senior management or the board, and how often?
good_answer_includes: Regular reporting with metrics, incidents and risks; frequency stated

question: Do you have an internal audit or independent function that checks security controls, and when did it last report?
good_answer_includes: Independent function, audit plan covering security, date and summary of last results

question: Do you keep an up-to-date inventory of the systems, software and data used to deliver our service, including where our data is stored?
good_answer_includes: Inventory covering hardware, software, cloud services and data stores for the service; owner per asset; update frequency

question: How is our data classified and labelled, and which handling rules apply to each class?
good_answer_includes: Classification scheme, our data's class, handling rules per class

question: How are our data and the media holding it securely deleted or destroyed when no longer needed?
good_answer_includes: Method (cryptographic erasure, certified destruction), timeframe, certificates of destruction

question: Are measures in place to prevent unauthorised copying or transfer of our data (data loss prevention)?
good_answer_includes: Controls on email, web upload, removable media and cloud sharing; alerts reviewed

question: Are staff and contractors who can access our data or systems background-checked, trained in security at least yearly, and bound by confidentiality terms?
good_answer_includes: Checks performed (identity, right to work, criminal or credit where lawful), training content and completion rate, confidentiality clauses
evidence_expected: Screening policy; training completion report; NDA template

question: How quickly are access rights and company devices removed when someone leaves or changes role?
good_answer_includes: Same-day removal for leavers; access review on role change; asset return checked

question: Do staff receive training on phishing and social engineering, and do you test it?
good_answer_includes: Regular training; simulated phishing; follow-up for repeat failures

question: What security rules apply when staff work remotely on our service?
good_answer_includes: Managed devices, secure connection, no local copies of our data, privacy screens where relevant

question: Are the sites where our data or service is handled protected against unauthorised physical access and environmental threats?
good_answer_includes: Access control at entry, visitor process, CCTV, environmental protection; list of sites covered
evidence_expected: Site security standard; data-centre certificate or report

question: If our data is hosted in your own or a colocation data centre, which independent assurance covers that facility?
good_answer_includes: Facility named; certificate or audit report covering it

question: How is physical access to secure areas reviewed and removed?
good_answer_includes: Regular access-list reviews; removal on leaving

question: Do you have controlled processes for changes, backups and capacity for the systems that deliver our service?
good_answer_includes: Change approval and testing, backup schedule and restore tests, capacity monitoring
evidence_expected: Change procedure; backup policy; restore test record

question: How are changes to production approved, tested and recorded, including emergency changes?
good_answer_includes: Approval before deployment, testing, segregation of duties, emergency changes reviewed afterwards
evidence_expected: Change records sample; SOC 2 change-management results

question: How often are backups of our data taken, where are they stored, and when was a restore last tested successfully?
good_answer_includes: Frequency meeting our recovery point needs; separate and protected storage; immutable or offline copy; restore test date

question: Are development, test and production environments separated, and is production data kept out of test?
good_answer_includes: Separate environments and access; production data masked or synthetic in test

question: Are the networks used for our service segmented, protected at their boundaries and monitored?
good_answer_includes: Segmentation between customers and environments, firewalls or equivalent, intrusion detection, monitored boundaries

question: Is our data separated from other customers' data (logically or physically), and how is that tested?
good_answer_includes: Tenant isolation design and testing

question: If you will connect to our network, how will the connection be secured, limited and monitored?
good_answer_includes: Dedicated or encrypted link, least-privilege rules, MFA, monitoring, no transitive access

question: How are your internet-facing services protected against denial-of-service attacks?
good_answer_includes: DDoS protection service or capacity; tested; response plan

question: Are laptops and other devices used for our service centrally managed, encrypted and protected against malware?
good_answer_includes: Central management, full-disk encryption, endpoint protection or EDR, patching, no personal devices without controls

question: Can staff install software or use removable media on devices that access our data?
good_answer_includes: Installation restricted to approved software; removable media blocked or controlled

question: How are endpoint security alerts detected and handled?
good_answer_includes: EDR alerts monitored 24x7 or within defined hours; response procedure

question: Are servers, databases and platforms that host our data or service hardened to a documented standard and kept up to date?
good_answer_includes: Hardening baseline (e.g. CIS), configuration drift monitoring, supported software versions

question: How do you detect and correct configuration changes that weaken security?
good_answer_includes: Configuration monitoring, alerts, correction timeframes

question: Do any systems that support our service run software that is no longer supported by its supplier?
good_answer_includes: None, or a list with compensating controls and replacement dates

question: Do you collect, protect and review security logs for the systems that deliver our service?
good_answer_includes: Log sources, central collection, protection from tampering, review or alerting, retention period

question: How long do you keep security logs, and can you provide relevant logs to us during an investigation?
good_answer_includes: Retention period meeting our and regulatory requirements (e.g. 180 days in India where CERT-In applies); time to provide logs

question: Are system clocks synchronised to a reliable time source?
good_answer_includes: Central time synchronisation for all systems

question: Who monitors security alerts, during which hours, and how fast are critical alerts acted on?
good_answer_includes: In-house or managed SOC, coverage hours (24x7 for critical services), response targets

question: Will your staff or systems access our systems or data? If yes, is multi-factor authentication enforced for that access?
good_answer_includes: Who will have access and how many people; MFA for all access to our data and for all remote and administrative access

question: Is multi-factor authentication required for all remote access, all administrative access and all access to our data, with no exceptions?
good_answer_includes: MFA scope stated; phishing-resistant methods for privileged users; any exceptions listed with compensating controls
evidence_expected: MFA configuration evidence; SOC 2 test result

question: How is privileged (administrator) access approved, limited, recorded and reviewed?
good_answer_includes: Approval, least privilege, separate admin accounts, just-in-time or vaulted access, session recording, regular review

question: How often are user access rights to systems holding our data reviewed, and by whom?
good_answer_includes: At least half-yearly for privileged and yearly for other access; review by the owner; removals tracked

question: How are shared, service and system accounts and their credentials controlled?
good_answer_includes: Inventory of non-human accounts, owners, no shared personal use, secrets stored in a vault, rotation

question: Do you develop or customise software used in our service? If yes, do you follow a secure development process with security testing before release?
good_answer_includes: Secure development lifecycle, threat modelling, code review, automated security testing, release gates

question: Which security tests run before release (static and dynamic testing, dependency and secret scanning), and do Critical or High issues block release?
good_answer_includes: Named test types, coverage, blocking rules for Critical/High issues

question: How do you manage open-source and third-party components in your software (inventory, vulnerabilities, licences)?
good_answer_includes: Software bill of materials, dependency scanning, update timeframes

question: Who can change source code and the build pipeline, and how are code and releases protected from tampering?
good_answer_includes: Restricted repository access, reviewed changes, protected branches, signed builds or artefacts

question: Do you have a documented and tested incident response process, and will you notify us of incidents affecting our data or service within an agreed time?
good_answer_includes: Owner, process, last test date; notification time in hours and contact route

question: Within how many hours of detecting an incident affecting our data or service will you notify us, and what information will you provide?
good_answer_includes: Notification time that lets us meet our regulatory deadlines (e.g. RBI and CERT-In 6 hours where they apply); initial and follow-up content
regimes: baseline; EU-DORA; IN-RBI; IN-CERT-In; IN-DPDP; EU-GDPR

question: Have you had a security incident or data breach in the last 36 months that affected customers or their data? What changed afterwards?
good_answer_includes: Honest summary, customers affected, lessons and improvements

question: How do you preserve evidence during an incident, and will you support our investigation?
good_answer_includes: Evidence preservation, chain of custody, cooperation commitment

question: Do you have business continuity and disaster recovery plans covering our service, tested within the last 12 months?
good_answer_includes: Plans covering our service, recovery time and point objectives, test date and result

question: What are the recovery time and recovery point objectives for our service, and did the last test meet them?
good_answer_includes: RTO and RPO compatible with our needs; test results against them

question: Which of your own suppliers and sites would stop our service if they failed, and how is that covered?
good_answer_includes: Dependency map of critical suppliers and sites; alternatives or redundancy

question: Do you include customers in continuity tests, and will you take part in our resilience tests if required?
good_answer_includes: Customer participation on request; regulatory testing support where required

question: Will you allow us, and our regulators where required, to audit or obtain audit results for the service?
good_answer_includes: Right to audit or to receive independent reports; regulator access where required; pooled audits accepted

question: Which laws, regulations and standards apply to your delivery of this service, and how do you track compliance with them?
good_answer_includes: List of applicable requirements; compliance owner; monitoring

question: Have you been subject to regulatory action, fines or legal proceedings related to security, privacy or service failures in the last 5 years?
good_answer_includes: Disclosure with outcome

question: Will you process personal data on our behalf? If yes, in which countries, for which purposes, and under which legal safeguards?
good_answer_includes: Categories of data and people, purposes limited to our instructions, countries, transfer mechanism
evidence_expected: Data processing agreement; record of processing extract

question: Will you sign a data processing agreement that limits processing to our instructions and covers sub-processors, assistance, deletion and audits?
good_answer_includes: Agreement with all required terms; sub-processor approval or notice

question: Will personal data be transferred to or accessed from another country? If yes, which mechanism and risk assessment support the transfer?
good_answer_includes: Countries; approved transfer mechanism; transfer risk assessment; localisation rules respected

question: How do you help us respond to requests from individuals (access, correction, deletion) and to personal-data breaches?
good_answer_includes: Process and timeframes for assistance

question: Is our data encrypted in transit and at rest, and who manages the encryption keys?
good_answer_includes: Current protocols (e.g. TLS 1.2 or later), at-rest encryption with strong algorithms, key ownership and storage

question: How are encryption keys generated, stored, rotated and destroyed, and who can access them?
good_answer_includes: Hardware security modules or managed key service, rotation periods, restricted access, option for customer-managed keys

question: Are backups and data on portable media also encrypted?
good_answer_includes: Encryption of backups and removable media

question: Do you scan for and fix vulnerabilities within defined timeframes, and have an independent penetration test at least yearly?
good_answer_includes: Scanning frequency, fix timeframes by severity, last penetration test date and tester

question: What are your fix timeframes for Critical and High vulnerabilities, and how well were they met in the last 6 months?
good_answer_includes: Timeframes (e.g. Critical ≤ 14 days, High ≤ 30 days) and compliance figures

question: When was the last independent penetration test of the service, what was its scope, and are any Critical or High findings still open?
good_answer_includes: Date within 12 months, independent tester, scope covering the service, status of findings
evidence_expected: Penetration test executive summary; remediation tracker

question: How do you use threat intelligence to protect the service?
good_answer_includes: Sources, how intelligence leads to action

question: Is our service delivered using cloud services? If yes, which providers and regions, and how are security responsibilities split between you, the provider and us?
good_answer_includes: Providers, service models (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS), regions, shared-responsibility matrix

question: How are your cloud accounts secured (identity, configuration monitoring, logging), and what independent evidence covers this?
good_answer_includes: Central identity with MFA, configuration posture monitoring, logging, CSA STAR or other assurance
evidence_expected: CSPM summary; CAIQ v4.1 or STAR entry

question: Can our data be kept in specific regions, and how will you inform us before changing regions or cloud providers?
good_answer_includes: Region choice; advance notice of changes; our right to object

question: Will any subcontractors or other third parties be involved in delivering our service or handling our data? If yes, please list them.
good_answer_includes: Each subcontractor: name, service, data access, location; or a clear No

question: How do you assess and monitor the security of your own critical suppliers?
good_answer_includes: Risk-based due diligence, contract security terms, periodic review

question: Will you ask our approval, or give us advance notice with a right to object, before adding or changing subcontractors for our service?
good_answer_includes: Prior approval for material subcontracting; notice period; right to object or terminate

question: Do your contracts with subcontractors pass down the security, audit and confidentiality obligations you owe us?
good_answer_includes: Flow-down of key obligations

question: Do you use artificial intelligence in our service or on our data? If yes, is our data used to train or improve models, and can that be switched off?
good_answer_includes: Where AI is used, model providers, whether our data trains models, opt-out by default for training

question: How do you govern AI in the service (risk assessment, human oversight, testing for errors and bias, logging)?
good_answer_includes: AI policy, risk assessment, human review of significant outputs, testing, ISO/IEC 42001 if held
evidence_expected: AI policy; ISO/IEC 42001 certificate if any

question: Can AI agents or automated tools in the service take actions on our systems or data? If yes, how are their permissions limited and monitored?
good_answer_includes: Least-privilege permissions, human approval for significant actions, logging

question: Which third-party AI model providers process our data, where, and under which terms?
good_answer_includes: Providers, regions, retention and training terms

question: Do you have policies on anti-bribery, modern slavery, ethical conduct and whistleblowing that apply to this service?
good_answer_includes: Policies, training, reporting channel

question: Have you or your owners been subject to investigations or sanctions for bribery, corruption, labour or environmental violations in the last 5 years?
good_answer_includes: Disclosure with outcome

question: Can you provide recent audited financial statements or equivalent evidence of financial stability?
good_answer_includes: Audited statements for the last 2 years, auditor's opinion, no going-concern warning

question: Are there any events (losses, debt problems, legal claims, change of ownership) that could affect your ability to deliver the service in the next 24 months?
good_answer_includes: Disclosure of material events

question: What insurance do you hold that would respond to a security incident or service failure affecting us (e.g. cyber, professional indemnity)?
good_answer_includes: Insurance types and limits; insurer

question: When the contract ends, will you return or securely delete our data and support a transition to another provider?
good_answer_includes: Data return format and timeframe, certified deletion, transition support period

question: Do you have a documented exit plan for our service, and has it been tested?
good_answer_includes: Plan covering data, services, knowledge transfer and timelines; test or walkthrough date

question: In which formats will our data be returned, and how long after termination will copies (including backups) be deleted?
good_answer_includes: Open or agreed formats; deletion including backups within a stated period; certificate

question: How long would you continue to provide the service after termination notice to allow us to move to another provider?
good_answer_includes: Termination assistance period matching our replacement time
